applicability: Native selected-chat sets in a listed embedded web page and their dashboard presentation.

exclusions: Launcher intent, navigation acknowledgements, URL, color, focus and mount state do not establish native selection.
Hidden cached tabs and DOM candidates absent from the current SDK catalog are excluded.

evidence: F2 unknown-ID/late-catalog/removal/reconnect cases; actual native same-URL tab click and two-live-pane native/AR set equality.
